function: Super-resolution prediction of the 3.5 GHz C-band channel sequence at finer temporal resolution, aided by sub-1G channels to resolve Doppler phase ambiguity (pp. 1, 5-7).
system: TDD multi-user MIMO, BS with 32 dual-polarized UPA antennas per band (C-band 3.5 GHz, sub-1G 0.9 GHz), K=5 single-antenna UEs, no RIS (pp. 3, 10).
method: CNN-LSTM dual-band fusion feeding an LSTM plus neural ODE with modulated-periodic MLP (sine and ReLU); supervised with future channels as labels, negative spectral efficiency loss, Adam (pp. 7-10).
data_channel: Dataset generated with 3GPP TR 38.901 urban macro-cell model (LOS and NLOS), 3.5 GHz C-band and 0.9 GHz sub-1G; 48,640 training and 2,560 test samples (pp. 10-11).
test_conditions: Default 80 km/h, J=9 history, P=7 predictions, 5 dB SNR; sweeps over speed, SNR, Te, angular deviation; training condition of each sweep not stated (pp. 10, 12-14).
baselines: Learned: CNN-LSTM [17], ODE-LSTM [27], tanh and sigmoid MLP dynamics; ablations without sub-1G and periodic-only MLP; no classical predictor simulated (pp. 11-13).
metrics: Average spectral efficiency (bps/Hz) of ZF downlink precoding with predicted channels; model parameters, FLOPs, running time (pp. 10, 12-13).
complexity: Table V: 5.073e6 parameters, 1.934e8 FLOPs, 4.283 ms running time on RTX 4090 for the proposed scheme (pp. 12-13).
q1_support: p. 10: "the channel model of 3GPP TR 38.901 for urban macro-cell scenarios is used to generate the data set", used for training and testing.
q2_support: p. 11: "The training data set and the test data set consist of" 48,640 and 2,560 samples of one configuration; the sweeps on pp. 12-14 (speed, SNR, Te, angular deviation) never state a different training condition.
q3_support: p. 11: "we compare the following schemes", namely proposed, proposed without sub-1G, ODE-LSTM [27] and CNN-LSTM [17]; all learned, and no non-learned predictor (AR, Kalman, Prony) or outdated channel appears in any result.
q4_support: p. 12: "numbers of floating-point operations (FLOPs), and running times for different schemes are summarized in Table V"; Table V (p. 13): 5.073e6 parameters, 1.934e8 FLOPs, 4.283 ms.
q5_support: p. 10: "is used to generate the data set" (self-generated simulation data); no link, DOI or availability statement for code or data appears anywhere in the paper.
notes: Channel prediction for TDD MIMO with dual-band side information, so area 2; no RIS. Tables I-V read from the PDF images (pp. 3, 10-13). The paper does not say whether models are retrained or reused across the sweep points, so q2 is 0. q3 is 0 because the learned baselines CNN-LSTM and ODE-LSTM are not accompanied by any non-learned predictor.
